lead: A new directory under `benches/` breaks the whole workspace, and the error names a crate you never wrote.
body: `Cargo.toml`'s `members` glob is `benches/*`, so a non-crate directory there makes every `cargo` command fail with *"failed to read `…/benches/<dir>/Cargo.toml`"* — and nothing fails until the next `cargo` invocation, which may be a container later. Add it to the `exclude` list beside that glob, and run `cargo metadata --no-deps` as the cheap check.
